name: John F. Kennedy
hook: PT-109, Profiles in Courage and the Cold War flashpoints Jeopardy never stops asking about.

facts.label: the only president with a Purple Heart
facts.statement: JFK is the only U.S. president awarded the Purple Heart, for his PT-109 service in World War II.

facts.label: Profiles in Courage
facts.statement: Profiles in Courage, his 1956 book on eight brave senators, won the 1957 Pulitzer Prize; Ted Sorensen drafted much of it.

facts.label: Cuba
facts.statement: He authorized the 1961 Bay of Pigs invasion of Cuba and faced the Cuban Missile Crisis there in October 1962.

facts.label: "Ich bin ein Berliner"
facts.statement: In a 1963 speech in West Berlin he declared "Ich bin ein Berliner" — "I am a Berliner."

facts.label: Robert Frost
facts.statement: Robert Frost read "The Gift Outright" at his 1961 presidential inauguration.

facts.label: Cape Canaveral
facts.statement: Cape Canaveral in Florida was renamed Cape Kennedy to honor him, then changed back again.

facts.label: Robert McNamara
facts.statement: Robert McNamara was his Secretary of Defense, stayed on under LBJ, and later ran the World Bank.
